newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares hit new highs, real estate leads.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares hit new highs, real estate leads.

text.p: Swedish shares set a record closing high once again on Monday, fuelled by Friday's bullish mood on Wall Street and a strong performance from the forestry and real estate sectors.
The all-share index rose 0.59 percent to 2,120.11, beating the previous closing high of 2,110.86 set on Friday. Turnover was moderate at 3.37 billion crowns.
Drugs group Astra, which was behind much of last week's strong bourse performance, began the day on a strong note but fell back to close at 295.50 crowns, 0.50 down on the day.
The forestry sector index rose 1.99 percent. SCA rose three crowns to 142 crowns.
The property sector also outperformed the broad market. Diligentia, which debut on the bourse last week, gained four crowns to 84.50.
"We have a positive view on the share. It is cheap, although not the cheapest of the property shares on the market," one broker said.
